One of the things I loved most about making #Animals was getting to interrogate the complexities of marriage. Mark and Abby’s marriage in particular. The masks they wear, the bargains they make, the secrets they keep from each other and from themselves! The film asks: what happens when a crisis forces all of it into the light?  Exploring all of that with Ben was a gift. Since he’s not on social, I can safely say this here and pray that no one shows it to him 🤣 I’ve admired Ben as a filmmaker for a very long time, but getting to be directed by him AND act opposite him was a transformative experience. It changed me as an artist. As an actor, his performance is fearless and raw. As a director, he created an environment that invited EVERYONE to contribute at their highest level -  be vulnerable, take big swings, ask the scary questions, and really dig in. This entire cast and crew has my heart.  Can’t wait to hear your thoughts…. ❤️ #AnimalsNetflix

Sometimes, human words aren’t needed to explain the deepest kind of faith, instinct, and love. In this incredible security camera footage, a stray mother dog gently carries her tiny puppy right to the feet of a statue of Jesus. Faced with the cold, unpredictable streets and looking for a safe haven for her newborn, her purest instinct led her to a place of comfort, shelter, and peace. Animals possess a quiet wisdom and an emotional depth that constantly reminds us of the good in the world. A mother’s devotion knows no bounds—she will do whatever it takes to ensure her little one is safe, sheltered, and loved. This moment is a powerful reminder that protection, hope, and sanctuary can be found in the most unexpected ways, proving that love always finds a path through the dark. Let this be your daily reminder to slow down, hold your loved ones a little tighter, and keep faith in the small, everyday miracles happening around us. ✨🐶❤️ #petsafety #doglove #christ #thicommunity #CompassionMatters
